step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows two main data paths into an AWS environment for healthcare interoperability. The left path handles structured request flows: external NHS users on the N3/HSCN network connect via Direct Connect (DX) to an Integration Service running as a microservice on EC2 with its own RDS PostgreSQL database. The Integration Service forwards normalized data requests to a FHIR Service microservice (EC2) with its own RDS instance. The right path handles unstructured document processing: local primary/social care settings mirror content via AWS Storage Gateway to an S3 bucket. S3 triggers events to SQS, which invokes Lambda to process document metadata/content and pass it to a Document Service microservice (EC2). The Document Service stores document metadata in an RDS instance and stores processed document content back into S3.
